path.id: Let's lay down a strict YAML schema structure for our local journals and capabilities.

Establishing a robust document structure ensures that our automated parsers can parse and link entity connections across your system ledger. By keeping all schema validation rules locally isolated within the engine block, we ensure high durability and absolute privacy.
The configuration defines explicit categories, trust decay thresholds, and backup targets. Please review this standardized schema block below:
